## Overview

- Improve fixed-preview layout spacing and add a subtle slide shadow for clearer presentation boundaries.
- Keep the Canvas Extension, Agent Skills, CLI, and Desktop on the unified 3.8.2 release.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible for existing Markdown decks. No migration is required.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v3.8.2`. |
